newsitem.title: USA: CME traders say USDA storage data neutral bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME traders say USDA storage data neutral bellies.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange traders said the U.S. Department of Agriculture's monthly Cold Storage Report was neutral for CME pork belly futures.

The report put frozen pork belly stocks, as of October 31, at 16.206 million lbs. The total was well within the range of 13.7 million to 21.0 million lbs predicted in a Reuter survey of analysts and close to the average projection of 16.0 million.
